source: the FLOR and TREE records of 101 plugins, the 5 masters and what C:\Thornswood\Profile\OwnGame\plugins.txt enables
rankedBy: the gold value of the produce, the thresholds in RANK_MAX_VALUE at the top of the script
harvestsAre: the plants whose produce is an alchemy reagent. A plant whose produce is food is not the gatherer's: food is bit 0x2 of an ALCH record's ENIT flag word, proved in scripts\dev\Build-RecipeTable.ps1, and those rows are in crops, game or unranked instead, but for the ones named in FOOD_STAYS_THE_GATHERERS at the top of the script
cropsRankedBy: how hard the crop is to grow, named one at a time in CROP_RANK_BY_EDITOR_ID at the top of the script, because the gold value is the gatherer's ladder and ranking a farm by it put every crop at advanced and left a new farmer nothing to sow
cropsAre: a plant of either record type whose produce carries the ALCH food bit and which is not hanging game, not a prop and not named as staying the gatherer's, plus the ones named in CROP_BY_EDITOR_ID at the top of the script; the HearthFires planters are left out
cropGrowMinutes: base + the produce value in gold x perGold, capped at max, and never under base, which is the hour the engine reloots a FLOR or TREE in on its own
fishAre: the records named in FISH_BY_EDITOR_ID at the top of the script, which are water produce and therefore the fisher's work rather than the gatherer's; the ones named in FISH_NOT_A_CATCH are left out and are in the unranked list instead
fishRankedBy: the Fisher rank named one at a time in FISH_RANK_BY_EDITOR_ID at the top of the script, because every one of these produce records is priced at 2 or 3 gold and the gold rule that ranks a plant puts all of them on one rung
gameAre: the plants whose produce is food and which are named in GAME_BY_EDITOR_ID at the top of the script: hanging game, which is the hunter's work rather than the gatherer's. They are not in game\data\hunts.json because that table is built out of NPC_ records and loot() only answers a reference the engine says is a dead actor, and a hanging pheasant is a FLOR standing in a camp
gameRankedBy: the Hunter rank named one at a time in GAME_RANK_BY_EDITOR_ID at the top of the script, because the three produce records are priced at 2, 3 and 4 gold and the gold rule that ranks a plant puts all of them on one rung
